parameters.name: DBInstanceName
parameters.description: The instance ID. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of all instances in the specified region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: ReadType
parameters.description:
The read/write type. Valid values:
- ReadWrite: row store read/write.
- ColumnarRead: column store read-only.
